author: Anna Schmidt
title: The Cameron County Fair returns for its 59th year - NewsBreak
text:
By Anna Schmidt ,
9 hours ago
CAMERON COUNTY, Pa. (WTAJ) — The remaining nights of the Cameron County fair are jam packed with with games, contests, live local music, and treats.
This year’s theme is “Celebrating 250 years of Freedom, Family, and PA Fairs.” The fair began on Aug. 2 and runs through Aug. 8.
Each night offers free parking and admission, live local entertainment, and artisanal fair foods.
10th annual Jan Hampton Conservation event – Wednesday August 5th Time Event 4 p.m. Fair opens 5:30 p.m. 18th Annual Chili Cook Off Judging 6 p.m. Chili Cook off Sale 6 p.m. CCOYA and the Turkey Federation conservation education sessions 6:30 p.m. Zucchini Parade 7 p.m. Howard Mincone, strolling entertainment 7-10 p.m. Off The Cuff on stage Military Appreciation Night – Thursday August 6th Time Event 4 p.m. Fair opens 5:30 p.m. Music Boosters Taste table 6 p.m. “Celebrity” Goat Milking 7 p.m. Cameron County Has Talent on stage 7 p.m. Howard Mincone, strolling entertainment 8 p.m. Nail Driving Contest Family Night – Friday August 7th Time Event 4 p.m. Fair opens 6:30 p.m. Beautiful Baby Contest Winner announced 7 p.m. Coronation ceremonies 7 p.m. Howard Mincone, strolling entertainment 7:30-10 p.m. Karaoke with the Royalty following coronation 8 p.m. Basket Bonanza Winners announced 9 p.m. Beaver Hall closes for 2026 fair On Saturday Aug. 8, the 22nd annual Harvey Gribble Memorial horseshoe tournament takes place at 8:30 a.m. to close out the 2026 Cameron County Fair.
